text:
priya: Quick sync  EdgeGate (marketplace) needs: SOC2 Type II executive summary, pen-test executive summary + vuln CSV (scanner output), completed vendor questionnaire export (PDF), and a signed attestation PDF for listing. They want an ingest + sanitized bundle flow. Who can own which part?

emily: I can take the ingest + checksum verification. Will drop raw uploads to s3://soc-golden/edgegate/1733334000/raw and create SHA256 manifests. ETA for first drop: tomorrow afternoon.

marco: I'll run redaction using redactr v0.9. Redaction policy: remove customer-identifying PII, redact IP-addresses (x.x.x.x -> [REDACTED-IP]), strip full auth tokens, and remove any customer-supplied config blobs. Keep high-level system versions and CVE IDs.

priya: Legal note from @legal-bot: attestation must include an explicit line that "no live customer data is included in the redacted artifacts" and we need a signatory (name + title + date). Also confirm we can preserve scan metadata (scan tool version, scan date).

legal-bot: Confirmed. Required attestation language: "We attest that the enclosed artifacts have been reviewed and redacted to remove customer-identifying information in accordance with Redwood's data handling policy. Signed: <name>, <title>, <date>."

si-integration: Partner portal requires a small manifest JSON (flat) next to the bundle with fields: partner_id, bundle_type, bundle_date, artifacts:CSV-list, redacted_by, contact_email, presigned_ttl_seconds, sha256_manifest. We'll upload the schema to the portal.

vendor-edgegate: Thanks folks. We prefer presigned links valid at least 72 hours and a single bundle to start. Also: include a high-level findings summary (1 page) for marketplace reviewers.

emily: Presign plan: upload redacted bundle to s3://partners/edgegate/1733334000/redacted/edgegate-bundle.zip then run:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://partners/edgegate/1733334000/redacted/edgegate-bundle.zip --expires-in 259200
```
I'll also publish sha256 sums to s3://partners/edgegate/1733334000/sha256.txt and include path in the manifest.

marco: Redaction runbook (short):
1) pull raw from soc-golden bucket
2) run redactr v0.9 with policy file policies/marketplace-edgegate.yml
3) manual quick review by security engineer (spot-check 3 random pages)
4) push to partners/edgegate/.../redacted
I'll tag the commit with redaction_id and put redacted_by=<engineer> in the manifest.

priya: Retention / golden copy policy: golden raw reports -> encrypted in soc-golden with lifecycle 2 years then move to cold archive. Redacted partner bundle -> 90 days then auto-delete. Document retention policy in the tracking sheet.

si-integration: Note: marketplace UI will fetch the manifest fields and expects presigned URLs to be included in an accompanying CSV with header: file_name, presigned_url, sha256, artifact_type. Please include that CSV next to the bundle.

emily: I'll generate the CSV via pipeline script (partners-ingest/publish_manifest.py). Example CSV row: 
"edgegate-soc2-summary.pdf,https://...,...,soc2-summary"

marco: Scheduling: I'll run first-pass redaction at 2024-06-06T10:00:00Z. Manual review by security at 2024-06-06T14:00:00Z. If all good, emily will presign and forward to EdgeGate.

priya: Action owners: ingest = emily, redaction = marco, attestation + sign-off = priya (legal loop), manifest + presigns = emily, retention/config = priya+leo (leo to accept retention SLA).

legal-bot: Also requested: include a short "allowed-disclosure" line in the manifest: "Allowed to share with marketplace reviewers only; not for redistribution."

vendor-edgegate: Sounds good. We'll confirm after we receive the presigned bundle. Thank you.

priya: I'll open a tracking ticket and post the link here. Thanks team :party_parrot:
